children: Geojit Financial Services research report on Tata Consultancy Services

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), a subsidiary of Tata Sons Ltd, is a global IT company providing services to the banking, financial services and insurance - BFSI; telecommunication; transportation; retail and manufacturing sectors. Consolidated revenue rose 11.2% YoY to Rs. 73,188cr in Q2FY27 owing to growth in the international market; better performance in BFSI, manufacturing and tech; artificial intelligence -AI revenue exceeding $3.1bn; and major deal wins. Europe revenue rose 12.0% YoY to Rs. 24,155cr on the back of strong growth in the UK, which reported 4.5% YoY constant-currency growth during Q2FY27. EBITDA rose 4.7% YoY to Rs. 18,815cr, while EBITDA margin contracted 160bps to 25.7%, due to higher other operating expenses (+35.0% YoY) and cost of equipment and software licences (+39.8% YoY). Adjusted profit after tax rose 5.1% YoY to Rs. 13,884cr on robust growth in global markets and strong profitability despite higher cost pressures.
We retain our BUY rating on the stock, with a revised target price of Rs.2,530 based on 16x FY28E adjusted EPS.
